categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three main business segments: (1) New energy battery intelligent equipment manufacturing, including continuous automatic mixing production lines for lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries, and integrated smart manufacturing solutions for positive and negative electrode sheets; (2) Organic silicon and polymer intelligent equipment manufacturing, including production lines for silicone rubber, sealants, and polyurethane products; (3) Materials production and sales through subsidiaries, including organic silicon materials, lithium carbonate, rubidium and cesium salts, and other advanced materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) Twin-screw continuous automatic mixing technology for battery electrode slurry production, achieving 4500L/h capacity and 95%+ market share; (2) Low-temperature sulfuric acid lithium mica extraction technology achieving 85%+ metal recovery rate with minimal tailings; (3) Continuous automated production line technology for organic silicon materials using advanced polymerization and synthesis methods; (4) Intelligent control systems utilizing sensors, AI, and remote monitoring for equipment automation and optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include lithium-ion battery manufacturers, sodium-ion battery producers, organic silicon material manufacturers, and new energy vehicle companies. End markets served include electric vehicles, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, photovoltaic applications, aerospace, medical devices, and industrial sealing applications. The company serves both domestic Chinese manufacturers and international customers across multiple continents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Foshan, Guangdong Province. Key operating locations include Foshan (headquarters and manufacturing), Jiangxi Province (lithium processing operations through subsidiaries), and Shenzhen. The company also maintains international presence through Hong Kong subsidiary and exports to multiple countries. Domestic market accounts for approximately 91% of revenue while exports represent about 9%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. For battery equipment, it manufactures production equipment used by battery manufacturers. For materials, it operates as both a processor (converting raw lithium mica into refined products) and a manufacturer (producing organic silicon materials and other chemical products). The company also engages in upstream activities through lithium mica mining operations via subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Solid-state battery equipment development and dry electrode process optimization; (2) Negative electrode material equipment expansion including silicon-carbon and hard carbon materials; (3) Lithium resource development and rare metal extraction from lithium mica; (4) Circular economy through waste battery recycling and intelligent disassembly equipment; (5) Organic silicon foam materials and advanced production systems; (6) AI and intelligent manufacturing system integration for remote monitoring and predictive maintenance.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment to battery and chemical manufacturers; (2) Sales of processed materials including lithium carbonate, rubidium salts, and cesium salts; (3) Sales of organic silicon materials and chemical products; (4) Equipment installation, commissioning, and after-sales service. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance and delivery of equipment or materials, with some contracts involving installation and testing requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a market leader in specific segments: it is the leading domestic supplier of continuous lithium-ion battery slurry mixing equipment with 95%+ market share, the first company to provide integrated positive and negative electrode sheet manufacturing solutions, and a leading organic silicon equipment manufacturer. Main competitors include other equipment manufacturers in battery and chemical sectors, though the company maintains technological advantages through proprietary twin-screw technology and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of approximately 1.51 billion yuan, down 33% from 2.25 billion yuan in 2023. The company reported a net loss of 80.7 million yuan in 2024 compared to net profit of 93.7 million yuan in 2023. Total assets are 4.21 billion yuan as of end-2024. The company has experienced significant growth historically but faced headwinds in 2024 due to market slowdown and product mix challenges, particularly in the lithium battery equipment segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: (1) Proprietary twin-screw continuous mixing technology enabling superior slurry quality and production efficiency; (2) Integrated one-stop solutions for battery electrode sheet manufacturing combining mixing, coating, and pressing; (3) Low-temperature lithium mica extraction technology producing 85%+ recovery with minimal environmental impact and valuable rare metal byproducts; (4) Comprehensive product portfolio spanning battery equipment, organic silicon equipment, and advanced materials; (5) Strong R&D capability with 81 patents and continuous innovation in intelligent manufacturing and material processing.
